tracked_link_clicks.rule: HEAD and declared serviqo-internal/livefeed checks are excluded. Other GETs whose User-Agent matches known_bot OR lacks Mozilla count as bot_tier; remaining GETs count as human_tier (browser-like traffic), never verified readers. This is not fraud-proof identity verification.
tracked_link_clicks.effective_from: 2026-10-27; earlier aggregate rows cannot be reclassified because raw User-Agents are not retained

edition_reads.rule: crawler if crawler matches; otherwise agent if agent matches or the User-Agent lacks "Mozilla"; otherwise browser. A read is not a verified reader.

funnel.rule: See /api/v1/funnel and /api/v1/pilot/candidates. Provenance is reviewed explicitly; a referral source does not establish independent ownership. Fetches, reviewed shares, attributed clicks and verified readers are separate.

receipts.note: Delivered and Received per agent and day, recomputable from published rows.

kept: No IP addresses or User-Agent strings are stored; only the class and daily counts.
